summary: Hitscan or projectile, both funnelling into the same Hurtbox as melee does.
overview: The ranged half of the combat core. Hitscan raycasts instantly for guns and lasers; Projectile spawns one that travels and hits on contact for arrows and thrown weapons. Both end up calling the same ReceiveHit, so a target needs no knowledge of which was used.
useCases: Arrows, thrown weapons and slow projectiles the player can dodge.
Switching a weapon between the two without touching the target's setup.

params.tuning: Both the origin and the aim direction. A muzzle pointing the wrong way is the usual reason shots miss everything.
Hitscan only. Remember Physics.queriesHitTriggers defaults to TRUE, so a trigger volume will stop a shot unless you exclude its layer.
Hitscan only. Projectile range is governed by the projectile's own lifetime instead.
Projectile only. Fast projectiles can tunnel through thin geometry between frames.

gotchas.title: Half the settings are mode-specific
gotchas.body: Range and hit mask do nothing in Projectile mode; the prefab and speed do nothing in Hitscan. Changing an ignored one and seeing no effect is expected.

gotchas.title: Triggers block hitscan by default
gotchas.body: Physics.queriesHitTriggers is true, so a checkpoint or pickup volume between shooter and target absorbs the shot. Put non-blocking volumes on Ignore Raycast.
